scope: Results section lines 17–72; 88 unambiguous in-scope gold claims only. R041 and R093 are out-of-scope assay observations; R085, R086, and R091 are source-disputed. Proposals are partitioned by source character offsets, regardless of candidate.source_unit.
scoring_rule: Complete requires one individual proposed record to preserve actor, relation, target, polarity, modality, material condition, temporal setting, and attribution. Separate proposal records cannot be combined for single-record complete recall. Candidate evidence is a locator and does not fill omitted graph fields. Null proposal modality is treated as an observed assertion when source evidence is an unhedged study result.
